reason: A browser-based local project workspace plugin that imports a user-selected folder to a server mirror and synchronizes DSH-originated file changes back to the local folder.

summaries.zh: 在浏览器中将用户选择的本地文件夹导入为服务器工作区，并通过 WebSocket 将 DSH 发起的文件修改同步回本地。
summaries.en: Imports a user-selected local folder as a server workspace and uses WebSocket updates to sync DSH-originated file changes back to the local folder.

capabilities: Reads files from a user-selected local folder
Uploads selected local files to a server-side workspace mirror
Writes server-side DSH file changes back to the local folder
Uses HTTP endpoints and WebSocket connections for workspace management and change delivery
Creates, lists, downloads, and deletes server-side workspace files
